explanation: The theorem is a spreading-out result for polarised abelian schemes. It descends the scheme, its group law, the polarisation sheaf and an endomorphism to a finitely generated ℤ-subalgebra of k. Its statement and proof rest on the library's own definitions (PolarisedAbelianScheme, RelativeGroupLaw, ProjPresentation, SPKit20.package_bc, and others). I did not run searches. Mathlib has no abelian schemes, polarisations or relative group laws, and none of the objects in the statement exist there. The proof uses only the library's own lemmas. So I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result or yields it in one or two lines.
